headline: Liberia Electricity Corporation Admits Illegal Bond Filing Before Supreme Court
summary: The Liberia Electricity Corporation admitted before the Supreme Court that its appeal bond to stay a $415,327 judgment failed to meet legal requirements, risking dismissal.
why: Legal and administrative compliance failures in state-owned enterprises pose direct contingent liabilities for sovereign fiscal health.

impacts.name: Liberia
impacts.why: Judicial liabilities for state utilities threaten public sector financial stability and creditor settlements.
